children: Oman’s Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning has received five bids for the construction of the 45-hectare Central Park and associated infrastructure within Phase 1 of Sultan Haitham City.
The financial bids for Phase 01, Work Package 09B (WP09B) were opened on 15 September 2026, according to tender board data.
Saif Salim Essa Al Harasi and Co submitted the lowest bid at 81.44 million Omani rials ($212 million). Other bids in ascending order include:
Al Tasnim Enterprises at OMR 104.69 million ($272 million)
Galfar Engineering and Contracting at OMR 109.82 million ($286 million)
Oasis Grace at OMR 153.67 million ($400 million)
Al Adrak Trading and Contracting at OMR 192.73 million ($501 million).

The contract covers construction of the Big Park (Central Park), including associated structures and wet and dry infrastructure utilities, across an area of approximately 45 hectares. The scope also includes tie-in connections to utility networks serving Sultan Haitham City.
Tender documents went on sale on 21 January 2026, while bids closed and financial offers were opened on 15 September.
(Writing by Deva Palanisamy; Editing by Anoop Menon)
